# **Hi, I’m posting this question for a friend who wishes to remain anonymous.**

 

He became a permanent resident approximately two years ago. Since then, his relationship with his Israeli partner ended, and he subsequently began a long-distance relationship with a German woman. They are expecting a baby, and he will be traveling to Germany in about a week for the birth. Their current plan is for the three of them to travel to Israel together for 2-3 months. After that, his partner will return to Germany and perhaps come back for another 2-3 months if possible. They do not intend to settle in Israel. Instead, he plans to relocate to Germany within about a year to join his partner and their child permanently.

Given these circumstances, he would like to know whether his partner and their baby will require any special permit \authorization \ invitation to enter Israel for these temporary visits.

Thank you, any input is appreciated!
